note: Tracked deferral ids that resolve to nothing outside the prose declaring them. SHRINK-ONLY: this list may lose entries as referents are found or deferrals honestly closed, and may never gain one. See scripts/lint-deferral-referent-resolves.mjs.
rebaselinedBecause: POPULATION WIDENING, not a regression. The first version of this guard matched CMT-\d+ / ACT-\d+ anywhere in spec prose. An external review on 2026-08-08 REJECTED that as an over-claim on two counts: a bare mention of an id counted as a tracked deferral, and every tracking marker using any OTHER id form was invisible. Measured at the fix: of 194 distinct <!-- tracked: --> marker ids in docs/specs, only 92 were CMT/ACT-numeric — 102 (53%) were outside the guard that claimed to police them. The population is now the marker itself, with the same character class the commit-time step admits. The orphan count moved 81 -> 104 because the guard now SEES more, not because the debt grew. Recording the reason here rather than silently re-running --update-baseline: a shrink-only ratchet that can be reset without an argument is not a ratchet, and the earlier number must stay legible as having been measured over a narrower population than its name implied.
